title: After the Diamond Stakes: Fully Prepared!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser gives her all at the Diamond Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Public opinion of Matikanetannhauser continues to rise. The race comes to a close with the crowd cheering louder than ever expected.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, in front of the racecourse, the reporter in the glasses finds out he's being transferred off of the Umamusume beat, despite just recently rediscovering his passion for the scene.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser has no way of knowing this, of course. Full of motivation and readier than ever, she looks forward to the upcoming spring Tenno Sho!
